description: React component for a modal dialog that prompts users to convert a channel to a private channel in Mattermost.

classes.name: ConvertChannelModal
classes.description: React component class for the convert channel modal dialog.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: handleConvert
methods.description: Handles the conversion of the channel to private by calling updateChannelPrivacy action.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with messages and buttons for user interaction.
